task_description:
Rework the SCRM Phase 2B bare-SNAPSHOT clipboard payload into a THREE-FLAVOR Windows transaction: (1) picture CF_DIB/CF_DIBV5 from a REAL egui/eframe window screenshot (not a text raster), (2) CF_UNICODETEXT Markdown-fenced text using proper Unicode box-drawing glyphs, (3) composite CF_HTML embedding the screenshot as base64 plus the box-drawn 
 text so Word shows both. All three placed in one clipboard-open transaction. ANSI stays off the clipboard; explicit SNAPSHOT  file outputs unchanged; no format picker; ff-screen-model stays egui-free; single dispatch seam; framework-conformance.
